description: Example POST /ml/review response from the rule engine. Every rule finding carries explanation, evidence (triggering added line, secret-redacted, <=200 chars), remediation (<=300) and caveat (<=300). Model findings may omit evidence. Shared by the Python schema test and the Java MlFinding deserialization test.

findings.explanation: A credential in source code is readable by everyone with repository access, stays in Git history after it is deleted, and cannot be rotated without a code change.
findings.remediation: Load the value from an environment variable or a secrets manager, rotate the exposed credential, and purge it from history if it was pushed.
findings.caveat: Matched on a credential-like name assigned a long quoted literal; fake test values and public identifiers can also match.
